name: json_diff
description: Structural diff of two JSON values: every added, removed and changed value with its JSON Pointer path (RFC 6901), arrays compared by index, by a key field or by longest common subsequence, and the RFC 6902 JSON Patch that turns the first into the second, verified by applying it. Also applies a JSON Patch (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test) atomically. JSON equality as RFC 6902 defines it: 1 equals 1.0, true is not 1.

a_text.description: Or the first value as JSON text

b_text.description: Or the second value as JSON text

catalog.source: RFC 6902 (JSON Patch) and RFC 6901 (JSON Pointer); LCS array diff after Hunt-McIlroy
